affected.instructions: Fixed right-handed axes: x points right, y up, z toward the front. Face directions: R=+x L=-x U=+y D=-y F=+z B=-z. A turn affects only pieces in its outer layer. Clockwise is viewed from outside looking inward at that face. Apply the rotation to the point and its sticker normal; a piece outside the layer stays unchanged. Is the selected piece in the layer being turned? Compare its current center with the face normal. Choose yes or no. Do not predict a new position yet.

criteria.yes: The piece belongs to the turned layer.
criteria.no: The piece lies outside the turned layer.

state.view: Straight at the turned face, from outside. Top of diagram is screen top.
